summary: Re-ran full existing backend (17 tests) and browser-check suite (8 checks) after the HSN/GST-rate projection fix in orders.py, plus finished/persisted the balance->PO->vendor->short-items lane and added a new public-preview-ingress browser check. All 9 browser checks and all 8 backend test files pass.

checks.criterion: Invoice lines and HSN summary carry the item master's real HSN and GST rate (regression of the fixed bug)
checks.name: test_tscheck_billing_invoice.py
checks.evidence: pytest: invoice for SUZ-SP-118 line hsn=85111000 gst_rate=28, hsn_summary row hsn=85111000 gst_rate=28; 18% part line/summary stayed at gst_rate=18. All assertions passed.

checks.criterion: Invoice lines and HSN summary carry the item master's real HSN and GST rate (regression of the fixed bug)
checks.name: billing-creates-gst-invoice-with-bill-to-other
checks.evidence: Re-run (reran-persisted): created invoice SI-2026-00021 for SUZ-SP-118 x4 at tag MRP 400, CUST004 bill-to-other flow. Response line hsn='85111000', gst_rate=28, cgst=224, sgst=224; hsn_summary row hsn='85111000' gst_rate=28. Printable invoice screenshot confirms non-blank HSN.

checks.criterion: Balance to PO, vendor receipt, shortage and resupply end to end
checks.name: test_tscheck_balance_po_vendor.py
checks.evidence: pytest passed: PO generated from balance+voluntary qty with PO-... number and ref containing source order ref; vendor invoice Allocated-Not-Received status; receive with MRP variance flag; approve-and-stock adds qty to warehouse stock and creates short row; resupply resolves short row and returns qty to stock.

checks.criterion: Balance to PO, vendor receipt, shortage and resupply end to end
checks.name: balance-po-vendor-receipt-and-short-items
checks.evidence: Re-run (reran-persisted) PASSED: full flow exercised in UI - balance row ticked with voluntary qty -> PO generated (PO-... number, ref contains source order ref, DMS xlsx link) -> vendor invoice created (Allocated Not Received) -> received qty entered with MRP variance flagged -> Approve & Take Into Stock closed dialog, incremented warehouse stock, created short row -> resupply on Short Received tab resolved it and returned stock.

checks.criterion: One check must exercise the public preview ingress rather than localhost
checks.name: public-preview-ingress-dashboard
checks.evidence: New check navigates to https://bike-parts-desk.preview.emergentagent.com/login, logs in with staff password 'suzuki123', lands on /dashboard on that same public host, and polls (since the public ingress loads ~2-6s slower than localhost) until Command Center cards resolve from placeholder dashes to real figures: PENDING ORDERS=33, READY TO BILL=12, OPEN PURCHASE ORDERS=6, STOCK VALUE=Rs 7,16,892.77, matching a direct curl of /api/dashboard on the same host.

notes: 17 checks total (8 backend test files run as a single pytest session = 17 passed assertions-worth of test cases, 9 browser checks) covering all 4 acceptance_matrix criteria (matrix criteria count = 4, within the 8-criterion cap). The previously found HIGH severity HSN/GST-rate projection bug is confirmed fixed by both the backend test and the billing browser check. The new public-preview-ingress-dashboard check required polling (toPass with retries) because the public ingress dashboard stats fetch resolves a few seconds slower than localhost; this is network latency, not a defect - data matches a direct curl against the same public host. All checks under /app/.emergent/scripts/checks/ are clean (no stray .backup files).
